regions.merged_text: P.S. Talking with Father Provincial last Wednesday he said we'd go back to Detroit together. He has been working on the Messenger and I think very probably we will be leaving here shortly - possibly Tuesday or Wednesday. I cannot say just when. God bless you again. Very best regards to V. Bro. Francis and to all our Dear ones.
